```{r}
library(Seurat)

library(Matrix)

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

source(here("scripts", "R", "utils.R"))
```

# Load h5 RDS

Load the rds file containing the merged Seurat object created by `combine_h5_counts.Rmd`.

```{r}
seu <- readRDS(here("results", "qc_experiment", "combined_cdna_seurat.rds"))
seu
```

## Guide pool QC comparison

```{r}
# Load guide counts from the pool QC
guide_counts_path <- here("results", "guide_pool_qc", "guide_counts.tsv")
guide_counts_qc <- fread(guide_counts_path)
# Normalize guide IDs (convert underscores to hyphens to match Seurat normalization)
guides_in_qc <- unique(gsub("_", "-", guide_counts_qc$guide_id, fixed = TRUE))

# Get gRNA counts from the Seurat object
if ("gRNA" %in% names(seu@assays)) {
  grna_counts_mat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "gRNA", layer = "counts")
  guide_umi_df <- data.table(
    guide_id = rownames(grna_counts_mat),
    total_umis = Matrix::rowSums(grna_counts_mat)
  )
  
  # Mark guides as being in the pool QC file
  guide_umi_df[, in_pool_qc := guide_id %in% guides_in_qc]
  guide_umi_df[, pool_status := fifelse(in_pool_qc, "In Pool QC", "Not in Pool QC")]
  
  # Plot the distribution
  p <- ggplot(guide_umi_df, aes(x = total_umis, fill = pool_status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("In Pool QC" = "steelblue", "Not in Pool QC" = "coral"),
      guide = guide_legend(title = "Guide Status")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "gRNA UMI Distribution: Pool QC vs All Guides",
      x = "Total UMIs per guide (log10 scale)",
      y = "Number of Guides"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p)
  
  # Summary statistics
  cat("\nGuide UMI Summary by Pool QC Status:\n")
  print(guide_umi_df[, .(
    count = .N,
    mean_umis = mean(total_umis),
    median_umis = median(total_umis),
    min_umis = min(total_umis),
    max_umis = max(total_umis)
  ), by = pool_status])
}
```

## Keep Only Pool QC Guides

```{r}
if ("gRNA" %in% names(seu@assays)) {
  grna_counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "gRNA", layer = "counts")
  grna_feature_meta <- seu[["gRNA"]][[]]
  guides_to_keep <- intersect(rownames(grna_counts), guides_in_qc)

  if (length(guides_to_keep) == 0) {
    stop("No overlapping guides found between gRNA assay and guide_pool_qc/guide_counts.tsv")
  }

  seu[["gRNA"]] <- Seurat::CreateAssayObject(
    counts = grna_counts[guides_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  # Preserve feature metadata (including element) after filtering guides.
  seu[["gRNA"]] <- SeuratObject::AddMetaData(
    object = seu[["gRNA"]],
    metadata = grna_feature_meta[guides_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  cat("Retained gRNA guides:", nrow(seu[["gRNA"]]), "\n")
  cat("Guides with non-missing element metadata:", sum(!is.na(seu[["gRNA"]][[]]$element)), "\n")
  cat("Cells retained:", ncol(seu), "\n")
}
```

## Compute QC metrics

```{r}
rna_feature_metadata <- seu[["RNA"]][[]]
gtf_path <- here("data", "gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
gene_type_cache_path <- here("results", "qc_experiment", "gencode_v32_gene_types.tsv")

gene_types <- fetch_gene_types_from_gtf(
  gene_ids = rna_feature_metadata$gene_id,
  gtf_path = gtf_path,
  cache_path = gene_type_cache_path
)
rna_feature_metadata$gene_type <- gene_types$gene_type
rna_feature_metadata$is_protein_coding <- rna_feature_metadata$gene_type %in% "protein_coding"

mito_features <- rownames(rna_feature_metadata)[
  grepl("^MT-", rna_feature_metadata$gene_symbol)
]
ribo_features <- rownames(rna_feature_metadata)[
  grepl("^RPS|^RPL|^RRP|^MRP|^FAU", rna_feature_metadata$gene_symbol)
]
targeted_features <- rownames(rna_feature_metadata)[
  rna_feature_metadata$is_readout_gene %in% TRUE
]
protein_coding_features <- rownames(rna_feature_metadata)[
  rna_feature_metadata$is_protein_coding %in% TRUE
]

stopifnot(length(mito_features) > 0)
stopifnot(length(ribo_features) > 0)
stopifnot(length(targeted_features) > 0)
stopifnot(length(protein_coding_features) > 0)

seu[["percent.mt"]] <- compute_feature_percentage(
  seu,
  features = mito_features,
  assay = "RNA"
)
seu[["percent.ribo"]] <- compute_feature_percentage(
  seu,
  features = ribo_features,
  assay = "RNA"
)
seu[["percent.targeted"]] <- compute_feature_percentage(
  seu,
  features = targeted_features,
  assay = "RNA"
)
seu[["percent.protein_coding"]] <- compute_feature_percentage(
  seu,
  features = protein_coding_features,
  assay = "RNA"
)
```

# Compare with scRNA

```{r}
# scRNA mean UMI counts
scrna_5prime_fnp <- here("data", "D0_10x5prime_pilot_counts_summary_ribo15_mt15_umi2000.tsv")
scrna_5prime <- fread(scrna_5prime_fnp)

output_dir <- here("results", "qc_experiment")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

counts_umi_mat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
rna_feature_metadata <- as.data.table(seu[["RNA"]][[]], keep.rownames = "feature_id")

mean_umi_df <- data.table(
  feature_id = rownames(counts_umi_mat),
  mean_umi_validation = Matrix::rowMeans(counts_umi_mat)
)
mean_umi_df <- merge(
  mean_umi_df,
  rna_feature_metadata[, .(feature_id, gene_symbol, ensembl_id = gene_id, is_readout_gene)],
  by = "feature_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

reference_umi <- copy(scrna_5prime)
umi_comparison_df <- merge(
  mean_umi_df[is_readout_gene %in% TRUE],
  reference_umi[, .(ensembl_id, mean_umi_reference = mean_umi, mean_upm)],
  by = "ensembl_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

x_thresh <- 30
y_thresh <- 1

umi_comparison_df[, mean_upm_plot := fifelse(is.na(mean_upm) | mean_upm <= 0, 0.01, mean_upm)]
umi_comparison_df[, mean_umi_validation_plot := fifelse(
  is.na(mean_umi_validation) | mean_umi_validation <= 0,
  0.01,
  mean_umi_validation
)]
umi_comparison_df[, quadrant := fifelse(
  mean_upm_plot >= x_thresh & mean_umi_validation_plot >= y_thresh,
  "Q1",
  fifelse(
    mean_upm_plot < x_thresh & mean_umi_validation_plot >= y_thresh,
    "Q2",
    fifelse(
      mean_upm_plot < x_thresh & mean_umi_validation_plot < y_thresh,
      "Q3",
      "Q4"
    )
  )
)]

# Load Table S3 and identify significant genes for WTC11
table_s3_path <- here("data", "Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv")
table_s3 <- fread(table_s3_path)

# Get the unique elements (gRNA targets) present in the Seurat object
grna_elements <- unique(seu[["gRNA"]][[]]$element)
grna_elements <- grna_elements[!is.na(grna_elements) & nzchar(grna_elements)]

# Filter for WTC11 cell line with significant == TRUE AND element in the gRNA assay
wtc11_significant_genes <- unique(
  table_s3[
    cell_type == "WTC11" & 
    significant == TRUE & 
    intended_target_name_hg38 %in% grna_elements,
    gene_id
  ]
)

# Mark genes as significant in the comparison dataframe
umi_comparison_df[, is_significant := ensembl_id %in% wtc11_significant_genes]

# Split quadrant counts by significance for on-plot labels.
quad_counts <- umi_comparison_df[
  , .(
    n_total = .N,
    n_sig = sum(is_significant %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_not_sig = sum(!(is_significant %in% TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = quadrant
]
quad_counts <- merge(
  data.table(quadrant = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")),
  quad_counts,
  by = "quadrant",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
quad_counts[is.na(n_total), c("n_total", "n_sig", "n_not_sig") := .(0L, 0L, 0L)]
quad_counts

x_min <- min(umi_comparison_df$mean_upm_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(umi_comparison_df$mean_upm_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(umi_comparison_df$mean_umi_validation_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(umi_comparison_df$mean_umi_validation_plot, na.rm = TRUE)

label_df <- data.table(
  quadrant = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
  x = c(
    10^(log10(x_thresh) + (log10(x_max) - log10(x_thresh)) * 0.8),
    10^(log10(x_min) + (log10(x_thresh) - log10(x_min)) * 0.1),
    10^(log10(x_min) + (log10(x_thresh) - log10(x_min)) * 0.1),
    10^(log10(x_thresh) + (log10(x_max) - log10(x_thresh)) * 0.8)
  ),
  y = c(
    10^(log10(y_thresh) + (log10(y_max) - log10(y_thresh)) * 0.5),
    10^(log10(y_thresh) + (log10(y_max) - log10(y_thresh)) * 0.5),
    10^(log10(y_min) + (log10(y_thresh) - log10(y_min)) / 2),
    10^(log10(y_min) + (log10(y_thresh) - log10(y_min)) / 2)
  )
)
label_df <- merge(label_df, quad_counts, by = "quadrant", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
label_df[, label := paste0(quadrant, ": ", n_total, " (sig: ", n_sig, ", non-sig: ", n_not_sig, ")")]

p <- ggplot(
  umi_comparison_df,
  aes(x = mean_upm_plot, y = mean_umi_validation_plot, color = is_significant)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey50", "TRUE" = "green3"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Not significant", "TRUE" = "Significant in WTC11"),
    guide = guide_legend(title = "Table S3 WTC11")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean UMIs per targeted gene vs reference scRNA",
    x = "Mean UPM in reference scRNA",
    y = "Mean UMIs per gene in validation dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "compare_to_reference_scRNA.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "compare_to_reference_scRNA.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

fwrite(
  umi_comparison_df[, .(
    gene_symbol,
    ensembl_id,
    mean_umi_validation,
    mean_umi_reference,
    mean_upm,
    quadrant
  )],
  file = file.path(output_dir, "gene_umi_comparison_quadrants.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
